name: Levi Asmodeus
original_name: レヴィ・アスモデウス
source:
[b]Class:[/b] Sniper
[b]Personality:[/b] Tsundere

Proud, stubborn, and tsun through and through...! But the moment someone genuinely praises her, she melts almost instantly.

Though she hates being treated like a child because of her small stature, she's actually a lonely girl who secretly craves affection.

Levi is a long-range specialist whose marksmanship ranks among the very best. 

She is the sole heiress of the prestigious House Asmodeus. Raised under the strict expectations of her noble family, she was taught that sniping was the only skill worth mastering. As a result, she's remarkably inexperienced in just about everything else.

Growing up, her older brothers rarely paid her any attention. Instead, they drilled the same lessons into her over and over: [i]"Be strong." "Handle it yourself."[/i] Because of that upbringing, she learned to rely on no one but herself.

She has a soft spot for berry-flavored sweets... and adorable little animals.

[b]Hopeless Trait:[/b] [i]Too Proud to Be Honest[/i]
No matter how hard she tries, everything seems to backfire.
Her pride keeps her from admitting mistakes or even asking for help, so even something as simple as reporting a problem becomes an ordeal.

To make matters worse, she has an extraordinarily sensitive body. Whenever she settles into a firing stance, the friction from her gear and clothing alone is enough to send distracting sensations through her most sensitive areas, making it nearly impossible to stay focused.

[b]Secret Memo:[/b] [i]Raised in a prestigious family that prized independence above all else, Levi has never learned how to lean on others or ask for affection.
But once she finally discovers what it's like to be spoiled...
...there may be no stopping her. [/i]

[b][i]"I-I-It's not like I like you or anything, okay!? B-But... if you're really going to beg me that much... then... I-I guess I wouldn't mind letting you do... whatever you want with me...!"[/I]
